title: A round 1 reviewer with the guard marker at line 1 of its brief still reported Haiku, not the Sonnet row of agent-model-cap
why: A guard change gets a cheaper reviewer than the table says, and the record can only state the model the reviewer reported.
source: Coordinator 16:36 CST Nov 13, from lane gh-quota-budget (PR #3288, record at head 878cc8433): the lane's report only, unchecked by the coordinator and by triage.
